svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'SF Pro Text', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: The gates every change must pass
svg.desc: Six capsules in two rows, joined in a U. Top left, outlined in amber, the optimized engine: the candidate under test, the only part that changes. It goes down into the first gate and must pass all four, in order: perft, move counts equal to the published ones; differential, results equal to those of the reference engine on millions of random positions; benchmark, cost measured against a baseline; and, back up at the top right, self-play, strength measured against the previous version. In the middle of the top row the reference engine, simple and readable, is the oracle: it feeds only the differential gate below it. The drawing is the process every change must pass, not a report of results.
